provenance.NKT_MV: Original NKT 33 kV XLPE-AL datasheet pp.19-20: conductor, XLPE, copper screen area/envelope, cable OD, resistance and direct-buried rating.
provenance.OES2: APSR Oman OES2 Fourth Edition 2024, 33 kV specification pp.20-21: nominal 0.8 mm semiconducting screens and resistivity limits. Design reference for missing data, not certified compliance.
provenance.MODEL: Equal-area Cu annulus at the given screen envelope. Residual SC contact bedding and effective PE cover are derived to close nominal dimensions; not claimed OEM layer dimensions.
provenance.INSTALLATION: No armour, pipe or common jacket: follows the selected NKT cable construction and direct-buried rating. Bedding/backfill homogenised with soil; discrete restraints omitted from the 2D section.

burial_depth_reference: trefoil_centroid; explicit assumption because NKT does not define the reference
